title: Crospi Playground content
description: Examples of the Crospi Playground (https://rob.pages.gitlab.kuleuven.be/crospi/) for this application package. Paths are relative to the package directory (the folder with package.xml), so they stay valid when the package is renamed with configure_template.sh.

path.description: Path relative to the package directory.

markers.description: Markers of the Markers tab (JSON, as saved by the playground; e.g. crospi_playground/markers/<id>.markers.json).

fake_inputs.description: Lua script of the Fake inputs tab (debugging aid of the playground; e.g. crospi_playground/fake_inputs/<id>.lua).

plots.description: Layout of the Plots (JSON, as saved by the playground; e.g. crospi_playground/plots/<id>.plots.json).

title.description: Name shown in the list of examples.

task.description: eTaSL task specification (Lua): one of a task library or a plain eTaSL file (crospi_playground/task_examples).

params.description: Parameters of the task (as the parameters of a task in a task list).

setup.description: Application setup (*.setup.json) used to run the task. Absent: the current setup is kept.

reset.description: Put the robot at the initial joints of the setup when the example is loaded (it is also done whenever the setup changes).

title.description: Name shown in the list of examples.

script.description: BeTFSM skill (Python); its task list is the .json file with the same name.

setups.description: Setups supported by the skill (Setup dropdown of the Skill mode); the first one is its default, loaded when the example is opened. The dropdown also offers the other setups of the folder ("show also unsupported setups"): with them the task list of the skill (<skill>.json) is used.

tasks.description: Task list adapted to this setup (e.g. another robot), instead of <skill>.json; kept in the folder of the skill: <skill>.<robot>.json (with crospi, copy it over <skill>.json, the task list loaded by the skill).

default_task_example.description: id of the Task example loaded on the first visit.

default_skill_example.description: id of the Skill example loaded on the first visit.

task_examples.description: Groups of examples of the Task mode.

skill_examples.description: Groups of examples of the Skill mode.
